name: focus_water_dig_eye
about: Standing in a 1x1 hole whose upper block is flowing water meta 3 (fluid top 63.667), dig the dirt east at feet level by hand (pitch 60 aims at it). 1.8.9 tests the eye at minY + 1.62 = 63.62 (in water: dig speed / 5, 76 ticks after float accumulation); 1.7.10 tests posY + 0.12 = 63.74 (not in water, 15 ticks).
